$comment: Any high match makes a PR HIGH; every low match is required for LOW; otherwise NORMAL.
The first three entries protect the review control plane.
Skill content is deliberately NORMAL: it is executable agent instruction, not documentation.
'.github/workflows/**' LEFT the high list on 2026-08-19 and is asserted in
review-policy-guard.yml instead, on the same reasoning that removed .gitignore on
2026-08-02: the hook tiers by path glob, so it cannot tell a permissions one-liner from
a rewrite of the deploy job, and bills a metered CodeRabbit review either way. Measured
over 100 HIGH PRs in the preceding 30 days: config-only diffs were 27 of them and
produced FOUR actionable comments between them, against 174 from code-bearing diffs,
while 45 of the 100 got no CodeRabbit verdict at all - throttled out at 73 reviews per
7 days against a 30/7d threshold. The glob was not buying review of workflow changes;
it was crowding out review of code.
Do NOT re-add it without first removing the corresponding assertions from the guard.
Deleting the guard itself needs no reviewer: "Review policy intact" is a REQUIRED
status check, so removing the workflow means the check never reports and no PR merges.
